subtitle: A trip planner app your AI fills in around your dates.
about: A small app inside a Pinto Notes note, with a countdown, daily plans, bookings and a packing list. Ask your AI to plan around your dates and interests, or fill it in yourself.

ask.prompt: Set up the trip plan template in my Pinto Notes.

slides.label: Plan the trip
slides.you: Plan 5 days in Lisbon from 6 December. I like food and views.
slides.ai: Your trip plan has a day for each of the 5 days, each with times.
slides.alt: Lisbon in the trip plan: 14 days to go, the bookings and the first day

slides.label: Add a booking
slides.you: Here's my flat in Alfama, already paid: 4 nights, check in 16:00 on 6 December.
slides.ai: Added it to Bookings and ticked it paid. 3 of 4 are paid now.
slides.alt: Bookings: the flat in Alfama ticked paid, 3 of 4 paid

slides.label: Use it yourself
slides.note: Or tick and edit it yourself.
